name: btn-creative-top

frames.best_why: The green fill covers the whole pill with the white label readable, and the cursor is clear of the button.

tagline: A white pill floods green from the bottom on hover.
summary: A pill-shaped Our Work link that starts white with black text. On hover a green fill slides up from the bottom edge to cover it, and the label turns white.
appearance: A white rounded pill with the words Our Work in bold black. On hover a bright green fill rises from the bottom until it covers the whole pill, and the label flips to white.
behaviour: Hovering slides a green layer up inside the pill while the black label fades out and a white copy takes its place. The green stays clipped to the pill's curve, and leaving sends it back down.
search_phrases: pill button filled green on hover
use_when: A portfolio or agency link should give a bright, obvious hover without adding an icon or second control.
avoid_when: The green fill and label are hardcoded, and the reveal is hover-only, so touch users never see the second state.
customise: The label, white surface and green fill colour are hardcoded classes; it takes no props, so every change needs a file edit.
weight_why: A pill, one green layer and a pair of CSS transforms.

a11y.note: Built as a div with cursor-pointer, it cannot be tabbed to or activated from the keyboard and is not announced as a button.

issues: The control is a div, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot activate it.
The description claims it turns rectangular on hover, but the outer pill clips the corners and the shape never changes.
polish_why: Bright and clear hover, but it is a basic colour-fill swap with little extra craft.
title: Top Slide Reveal Button
